Title: Dulwich: Symlink directory traversal in stash pop allows arbitrary file write via intermediate directory symlinks
Description: Dulwich's `stash.py:pop()` function is vulnerable to symlink directory traversal, allowing an attacker to write arbitrary files outside the repository worktree when a victim pops a stash in a malicious repository.
NotImpacted: All versions before 0.22.5, all versions starting from 1.2.8
